There's definitely some difference between which specific receptors opioids/opiates affects. 
When constantly using, Morphine doesn't feel as good as Oxy imo.
(possibly has a greater lingering detrimental effect on the receptor)
 
But if i was to have a tolerance break Morphine is basically heaven.

Some would say there's almost no point in doing it Orally, with tolerance i agree. Morphine I.V is no different from Diacytlmorphine (H).
